"""Typed request/result schemas for the hybrid_automation_v2 MCP tool surface.

Every tool returns a structured Pydantic result (never a bare string) so callers
get consistent success/error/evidence fields regardless of which action ran.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class BoundingBox(BaseModel):
    left: int
    top: int
    right: int
    bottom: int


class ActionResult(BaseModel):
    """Base result shape shared by every tool. Concrete tools extend this."""

    ok: bool
    tool: str
    message: str = ""
    error: str | None = None
    screenshot_path: str | None = None
    verify_screenshot_path: str | None = None
    duration_ms: int | None = None


class ScreenCaptureResult(ActionResult):
    image_path: str | None = None
    width: int | None = None
    height: int | None = None
    scale_factor: float | None = None


class TextMatch(BaseModel):
    text: str
    x: int
    y: int
    box: BoundingBox
    confidence: float | None = None


class ScreenInspectResult(ActionResult):
    image_path: str | None = None
    matches: list[TextMatch] = Field(default_factory=list)
    full_text: str | None = None
    ui_labels: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class FindResult(ActionResult):
    found: bool = False
    x: int | None = None
    y: int | None = None
    box: BoundingBox | None = None
    candidates: list[TextMatch] = Field(default_factory=list)
    source: Literal["vision_ocr", "gemini", "none"] = "none"


class ClickResult(ActionResult):
    x: int | None = None
    y: int | None = None
    button: str = "left"
    clicks: int = 1
    verified: bool | None = None


class DragResult(ActionResult):
    start_x: int | None = None
    start_y: int | None = None
    end_x: int | None = None
    end_y: int | None = None


class ScrollResult(ActionResult):
    amount: int = 0
    x: int | None = None
    y: int | None = None


class TypeTextResult(ActionResult):
    text_length: int = 0


class KeyResult(ActionResult):
    keys: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class WindowInfo(BaseModel):
    title: str
    left: int
    top: int
    width: int
    height: int
    is_active: bool = False
    is_minimized: bool = False


class ListWindowsResult(ActionResult):
    windows: list[WindowInfo] = Field(default_factory=list)


class FocusWindowResult(ActionResult):
    window: WindowInfo | None = None


class TileWindowsResult(ActionResult):
    left_window: WindowInfo | None = None
    right_window: WindowInfo | None = None


class OpenPathResult(ActionResult):
    path: str = ""


class WaitForTextResult(ActionResult):
    found: bool = False
    elapsed_ms: int = 0
    match: TextMatch | None = None


class ActionStep(BaseModel):
    """One step inside a run_action_plan call."""

    action: Literal[
        "screen_capture",
        "click",
        "double_click",
        "drag",
        "scroll",
        "type_text",
        "press_key",
        "hotkey",
        "focus_window",
        "tile_windows",
        "wait_for_text",
        "open_path",
    ]
    target_text: str | None = None
    x: int | None = None
    y: int | None = None
    end_x: int | None = None
    end_y: int | None = None
    text: str | None = None
    key: str | None = None
    keys: list[str] | None = None
    amount: int | None = None
    window_title_substring: str | None = None
    path: str | None = None
    timeout_s: float | None = None
    verify: bool = True


class StepResult(BaseModel):
    step_index: int
    action: str
    ok: bool
    message: str = ""
    error: str | None = None
    screenshot_path: str | None = None


class RunActionPlanResult(ActionResult):
    steps: list[StepResult] = Field(default_factory=list)
    stopped_early: bool = False

"""Vision grounding: Google Cloud Vision OCR for text, Gemini for non-text UI elements.

This is the additive v2 replacement for v1's fusion_utils.VisionFusionEngine — same
Vision OCR core, extended with multi-match results, confidence, bounding boxes, and
an optional Gemini fallback for elements that have no readable text (icons, sliders).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass

from models import BoundingBox, TextMatch


@dataclass
class VisionEngineError(Exception):
    message: str

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.message


class VisionEngine:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._vision_client = None
        self._genai_client = None

    @property
    def vision_client(self):
        if self._vision_client is None:
            from google.cloud import vision
            import google.auth

            credentials, _project = google.auth.default()
            self._vision_client = vision.ImageAnnotatorClient(credentials=credentials)
        return self._vision_client

    def ocr(self, image_path: str) -> tuple[list[TextMatch], str | None]:
        """Run OCR on the image, return (per-word matches, full detected text)."""
        from google.cloud import vision

        with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
            content = f.read()

        image = vision.Image(content=content)
        response = self.vision_client.text_detection(image=image)
        if response.error.message:
            raise VisionEngineError(f"Vision API error: {response.error.message}")

        annotations = response.text_annotations
        if not annotations:
            return [], None

        full_text = annotations[0].description
        matches: list[TextMatch] = []
        for ann in annotations[1:]:
            vertices = ann.bounding_poly.vertices
            xs = [v.x for v in vertices]
            ys = [v.y for v in vertices]
            box = BoundingBox(left=min(xs), top=min(ys), right=max(xs), bottom=max(ys))
            cx = sum(xs) // len(xs)
            cy = sum(ys) // len(ys)
            matches.append(TextMatch(text=ann.description, x=cx, y=cy, box=box, confidence=None))
        return matches, full_text

    def find_text(
        self, image_path: str, target_text: str, case_sensitive: bool = False
    ) -> list[TextMatch]:
        """Find every OCR match whose text contains target_text. Also tries to merge
        adjacent word matches into phrase matches for multi-word targets."""
        matches, _full_text = self.ocr(image_path)
        needle = target_text if case_sensitive else target_text.lower()

        direct: list[TextMatch] = []
        for m in matches:
            hay = m.text if case_sensitive else m.text.lower()
            if needle in hay:
                direct.append(m)
        if direct:
            return direct

        words = target_text.split()
        if len(words) <= 1:
            return []

        phrase_hits: list[TextMatch] = []
        n = len(matches)
        for i in range(n):
            window_words = []
            boxes = []
            for j in range(i, min(i + len(words), n)):
                window_words.append(matches[j].text)
                boxes.append(matches[j].box)
            candidate = " ".join(window_words)
            hay = candidate if case_sensitive else candidate.lower()
            if needle in hay:
                left = min(b.left for b in boxes)
                top = min(b.top for b in boxes)
                right = max(b.right for b in boxes)
                bottom = max(b.bottom for b in boxes)
                phrase_hits.append(
                    TextMatch(
                        text=candidate,
                        x=(left + right) // 2,
                        y=(top + bottom) // 2,
                        box=BoundingBox(left=left, top=top, right=right, bottom=bottom),
                        confidence=None,
                    )
                )
        return phrase_hits

    def find_element_gemini(self, image_path: str, description: str) -> TextMatch | None:
        """Fallback grounding for elements without readable text, using Gemini vision.
        Returns None (rather than raising) if the API/key is unavailable, so callers can
        treat this purely as a best-effort fallback after OCR misses."""
        try:
            from google import genai
            from PIL import Image
        except ImportError:
            return None

        api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY")
        try:
            client = genai.Client(api_key=api_key) if api_key else genai.Client()
        except Exception:
            return None

        img = Image.open(image_path)
        width, height = img.size

        prompt = (
            "You are a precise UI grounding model. Given the screenshot, locate the UI "
            f"element described as: '{description}'. Respond with ONLY a JSON object "
            '{"x": <int>, "y": <int>, "found": true} using absolute pixel coordinates '
            f"in an image of size {width}x{height}, or {{\"found\": false}} if it is not visible. "
            "No other text."
        )

        try:
            response = client.models.generate_content(
                model="gemini-2.0-flash",
                contents=[img, prompt],
            )
            text = (response.text or "").strip()
            text = text.strip("`")
            if text.lower().startswith("json"):
                text = text[4:].strip()
            import json

            data = json.loads(text)
            if not data.get("found"):
                return None
            x, y = int(data["x"]), int(data["y"])
            box = BoundingBox(left=x - 5, top=y - 5, right=x + 5, bottom=y + 5)
            return TextMatch(text=description, x=x, y=y, box=box, confidence=None)
        except Exception:
            return None

input.contents:
"""Local desktop smoke test for the v2 controller.

Deliberately drives disposable scratch windows (Notepad, Calculator) rather than
the user's real IDE/browser windows, so proving out capture -> find -> click ->
type -> verify -> tile -> cleanup can't disturb whatever the user is actually
working on. Run with the v2 venv's python; writes artifacts + a JSON summary
under runs/.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent))

import window_ops
from controller_core import ControllerCore, RUNS_DIR

core = ControllerCore()
summary: dict = {"steps": []}


def record(name: str, result) -> None:
    entry = {"step": name, "ok": getattr(result, "ok", None)}
    for attr in ("message", "error", "screenshot_path", "verify_screenshot_path", "x", "y", "found"):
        if hasattr(result, attr):
            entry[attr] = getattr(result, attr)
    summary["steps"].append(entry)
    status = "OK" if entry.get("ok") else "FAIL"
    print(f"[{status}] {name}: {entry.get('message') or entry.get('error')}")


def main() -> None:
    notepad_proc = subprocess.Popen(["notepad.exe"])
    calc_proc = subprocess.Popen(["calc.exe"])
    time.sleep(2.0)

    try:
        cap = core.screen_capture(label="smoke_initial")
        record("screen_capture", cap)

        focus = window_ops.focus_window("Notepad")
        summary["steps"].append({"step": "focus_window(Notepad)", "ok": focus is not None})
        print(f"[{'OK' if focus else 'FAIL'}] focus_window(Notepad): {focus}")

        if focus is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Notepad window did not appear")

        click_x = focus.left + max(focus.width // 2, 100)
        click_y = focus.top + max(focus.height // 2, 100)
        click_res = core.click(x=click_x, y=click_y, verify=True)
        record("click(notepad body)", click_res)

        marker = "hybrid_automation_v2 smoke ok"
        type_res = core.type_text(marker)
        record("type_text", type_res)

        find_res = core.find_text("smoke ok")
        record("find_text(typed marker)", find_res)

        left_info, right_info = window_ops.tile_windows("Notepad", "Calculator")
        tiled_ok = left_info is not None or right_info is not None
        summary["steps"].append(
            {
                "step": "tile_windows(Notepad, Calculator)",
                "ok": tiled_ok,
                "left_window": left_info.model_dump() if left_info else None,
                "right_window": right_info.model_dump() if right_info else None,
            }
        )
        print(f"[{'OK' if tiled_ok else 'FAIL'}] tile_windows: left={bool(left_info)} right={bool(right_info)}")

        cap_tiled = core.screen_capture(label="smoke_tiled")
        record("screen_capture(after tile)", cap_tiled)

        list_res = window_ops.list_windows()
        summary["steps"].append({"step": "list_windows", "ok": True, "count": len(list_res)})
        print(f"[OK] list_windows: {len(list_res)} window(s) visible")

    finally:
        for proc in (notepad_proc, calc_proc):
            try:
                proc.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass
        subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/IM", "notepad.exe", "/F"], capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/IM", "CalculatorApp.exe", "/F"], capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/IM", "calc.exe", "/F"], capture_output=True)

    overall_ok = all(s.get("ok") for s in summary["steps"])
    summary["ok"] = overall_ok

    out_path = RUNS_DIR / f"smoke_summary_{int(time.time())}.json"
    out_path.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, default=str))
    print(f"\nOverall: {'PASS' if overall_ok else 'FAIL'}")
    print(f"Summary written to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def tile_windows(
    left_title_substring: str, right_title_substring: str
) -> tuple[WindowInfo | None, WindowInfo | None]:
    """Tile two windows left/right across the primary display, matched by
    case-insensitive title substring. Returns (left_info, right_info); either may be
    None if no matching window was found."""
    screen_width, screen_height = get_screen_size()
    half_width = screen_width // 2

    left_info = None
    left_win = find_window(left_title_substring)
    if left_win is not None:
        try:
            left_win.restore()
            left_win.activate()
            left_win.resizeTo(half_width, screen_height)
            left_win.moveTo(0, 0)
        except Exception:
            pass
        left_info = _to_window_info(left_win)

    right_info = None
    right_win = find_window(right_title_substring)
    if right_win is not None:
        try:
            right_win.restore()
            right_win.activate()
            right_win.resizeTo(screen_width - half_width, screen_height)
            right_win.moveTo(half_width, 0)
        except Exception:
            pass
        right_info = _to_window_info(right_win)

    return left_info, right_info

def _with_failsafe_retry(fn, retries: int = 2, backoff_s: float = 0.3):
    """Run a pyautogui call, retrying past transient FailSafeException triggers.

    Multi-monitor + high-DPI setups can occasionally report a stale cursor
    position mid-transition (e.g. right after a window activate/restore), which
    momentarily reads as sitting exactly on a screen corner. A real user-invoked
    fail-safe (deliberately yanking the mouse to a corner) will still reliably
    reproduce across retries and eventually re-raise.
    """
    last_exc = None
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        try:
            return fn()
        except pyautogui.FailSafeException as exc:
            last_exc = exc
            if attempt < retries:
                time.sleep(backoff_s)
                continue
            raise
    raise last_exc  # pragma: no cover - unreachable, satisfies type checkers

content.text: Found the root cause: pyautogui's `_position()` on Windows doesn't check `GetCursorPos`'s return value, and that call intermittently fails (returning zeroed `(0,0)` — which looks like a corner) specifically around keyboard-only calls. Since fail-safe is meant to guard against runaway **mouse** automation, I'll scope it off for pure-keyboard actions rather than relying on this buggy path.

input.old_string: def _with_capture_retry(fn, retries: int = 3, backoff_s: float = 0.25):
input.new_string:
def _run_keyboard_only(fn):
    """Run a pure-keyboard pyautogui call (typewrite/press/hotkey) with FAILSAFE
    temporarily disabled for just this call.

    Windows' GetCursorPos (which pyautogui's fail-safe check reads) is called
    without checking its BOOL return value in pyautogui/_pyautogui_win.py; when it
    transiently fails (observed here, deterministically, immediately after mouse
    focus changes) the zero-initialized POINT struct reads back as (0, 0), which
    is indistinguishable from a real corner and false-triggers fail-safe. That
    protection exists to let a user abort a *runaway mouse*; it has no real
    bearing on keyboard-only actions that never move the cursor, so we scope the
    check off here rather than retry a check that's spuriously unreliable in this
    exact call path. Mouse-moving actions (click/drag/scroll) keep FAILSAFE on.
    """
    previous = pyautogui.FAILSAFE
    pyautogui.FAILSAFE = False
    try:
        return fn()
    finally:
        pyautogui.FAILSAFE = previous

**1. The `file:///C:/...` path (The Lazy Way)**

Your Refract app is advanced. It loads external 3D models (`chronograph.glb`), environment lighting (`studio.hdr`), and ES6 modules. 
Modern browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari) **strictly block** `file:///` URLs from loading other local files. It's a security measure so a random downloaded HTML file can't secretly read your hard drive. 

If I gave you the `file:///` path for the Animated Showcase, you would just stare at a black screen because Chrome would instantly block the 3D watch and the HDR lighting from loading. 

By running the Python pipeline server and giving you the `http://localhost` link, it tricks the browser into thinking it's a real, hosted website. The security block lifts, and the 3D assets load perfectly.

**The Bottom Line:**
Because Refract is a high-end 3D app using `.glb` and `.hdr` files, **it will always need to be `localhost`**. I will stick exclusively to the `localhost` pipeline so it stops inconsistently jumping between the two.

"""Agent Secrets Vault - local credential capture GUI.

Secrets-best-practice notes:
- Credentials are written ONLY to Windows Credential Manager (DPAPI-encrypted,
  bound to this Windows user) via `keyring`.
- Nothing is written to disk, chat, logs, or agent transcripts.
- Agents later reference secrets by service name only (e.g. "agent:Pinterest").
"""

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk

import keyring

INK = "#05060a"
PANEL = "#0b0e16"
BLUE = "#00a2ff"
LIME = "#57ff6b"
PINK = "#ff1f6e"
TEXT = "#dfe7ff"
MUTED = "#8fa2c4"


def save(service_var, user_var, password_entry, status):
    service = service_var.get().strip()
    username = user_var.get().strip()
    password = password_entry.get()
    if not service or not username or not password:
        status.config(text="All three fields are required.", fg=PINK)
        return
    key = f"agent:{service}"
    keyring.set_password(key, username, password)
    keyring.set_password(key, "__username__", username)
    password_entry.delete(0, tk.END)
    status.config(
        text=f"Saved to Windows Credential Manager as '{key}'. Safe to close.",
        fg=LIME,
    )


def main():
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.title("AGENT SECRETS VAULT")
    root.configure(bg=INK)
    root.geometry("520x360")
    root.attributes("-topmost", True)

    tk.Label(
        root, text="AGENT  //  SECRETS  VAULT", bg=INK, fg=BLUE,
        font=("Segoe UI", 15, "bold"),
    ).pack(pady=(26, 2))
    tk.Label(
        root,
        text="Stored in Windows Credential Manager (encrypted). Never sent to chat or files.",
        bg=INK, fg=MUTED, font=("Segoe UI", 9),
    ).pack(pady=(0, 18))

    panel = tk.Frame(root, bg=PANEL, padx=26, pady=20)
    panel.pack(fill="x", padx=30)

    def field(label):
        tk.Label(panel, text=label, bg=PANEL, fg=TEXT, font=("Segoe UI", 10, "bold"), anchor="w").pack(fill="x", pady=(8, 2))

    field("SERVICE")
    service_var = tk.StringVar(value="Pinterest")
    tk.Entry(panel, textvariable=service_var, bg=INK, fg=TEXT, insertbackground=BLUE,
             relief="flat", font=("Segoe UI", 11)).pack(fill="x", ipady=6)

    field("EMAIL / USERNAME")
    user_var = tk.StringVar()
    tk.Entry(panel, textvariable=user_var, bg=INK, fg=TEXT, insertbackground=BLUE,
             relief="flat", font=("Segoe UI", 11)).pack(fill="x", ipady=6)

    field("PASSWORD")
    password_entry = tk.Entry(panel, show="\u2022", bg=INK, fg=TEXT, insertbackground=BLUE,
                              relief="flat", font=("Segoe UI", 11))
    password_entry.pack(fill="x", ipady=6)

    status = tk.Label(root, text="", bg=INK, fg=MUTED, font=("Segoe UI", 9))
    status.pack(pady=(12, 0))

    tk.Button(
        root, text="SAVE SECURELY", command=lambda: save(service_var, user_var, password_entry, status),
        bg=BLUE, fg=INK, activebackground=LIME, relief="flat",
        font=("Segoe UI", 11, "bold"), padx=26, pady=8, cursor="hand2",
    ).pack(pady=14)

    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Screenshot a tab of the agent Chrome (CDP :9333) to a PNG file. No secrets echoed."""
import base64
import json
import sys
import urllib.request

import asyncio
import websockets


async def shot(match: str, out_path: str):
    with urllib.request.urlopen("http://localhost:9333/json/list") as response:
        pages = [p for p in json.loads(response.read().decode()) if p.get("type") == "page"]
    page = next((p for p in pages if match.lower() in p.get("url", "").lower()), pages[0] if pages else None)
    if not page:
        print("NO PAGE")
        return
    async with websockets.connect(page["webSocketDebuggerUrl"], max_size=50_000_000) as ws:
        await ws.send(json.dumps({"id": 1, "method": "Page.enable"}))
        await ws.recv()
        await ws.send(json.dumps({"id": 2, "method": "Page.captureScreenshot", "params": {"format": "png"}}))
        while True:
            msg = json.loads(await ws.recv())
            if msg.get("id") == 2:
                data = msg["result"]["data"]
                break
    with open(out_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(base64.b64decode(data))
    print(f"SAVED {out_path} url={page['url']}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(shot(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "", sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else r"C:\Users\joeyw\.agent-browser\shot.png"))

import json
import sys
import urllib.request

import asyncio
import websockets


async def run(match: str, expression: str):
    with urllib.request.urlopen("http://localhost:9333/json/list") as response:
        pages = [p for p in json.loads(response.read().decode()) if p.get("type") == "page"]
    page = next((p for p in pages if match.lower() in p.get("url", "").lower()), pages[0] if pages else None)
    if not page:
        print("NO PAGE")

            "id": 1,
            "method": "Runtime.evaluate",
            "params": {"expression": expression, "returnByValue": True, "awaitPromise": True},

        while True:
            msg = json.loads(await ws.recv())
            if msg.get("id") == 1:
                result = msg.get("result", {}).get("result", {})
                print(json.dumps(result.get("value"), ensure_ascii=False)[:4000])

    with urllib.request.urlopen("http://localhost:9333/json/list") as response:

"""Scroll the agent Chrome (CDP :9333) Pinterest tab by N wheel steps, then screenshot.
Pure input dispatch + screenshot. No DOM/cookie/storage reads."""
import base64
import json
import sys
import time
import urllib.request

import asyncio
import websockets


async def run(steps: int, out_path: str):
    with urllib.request.urlopen("http://localhost:9333/json/list") as response:
        pages = [p for p in json.loads(response.read().decode()) if p.get("type") == "page"]
    page = next((p for p in pages if "pinterest" in p.get("url", "").lower()), pages[0] if pages else None)
    if not page:
        print("NO TAB")
        return
    async with websockets.connect(page["webSocketDebuggerUrl"], max_size=80_000_000) as ws:
        await ws.send(json.dumps({"id": 1, "method": "Page.enable"}))
        await ws.recv()
        for _ in range(steps):
            await ws.send(json.dumps({
                "id": 2,
                "method": "Input.dispatchMouseEvent",
                "params": {"type": "mouseWheel", "x": 500, "y": 400, "deltaX": 0, "deltaY": 900},
            }))
            await ws.recv()
            time.sleep(0.7)
        time.sleep(2)
        await ws.send(json.dumps({"id": 3, "method": "Page.captureScreenshot", "params": {"format": "png"}}))
        while True:
            msg = json.loads(await ws.recv())
            if msg.get("id") == 3:
                with open(out_path, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(base64.b64decode(msg["result"]["data"]))
                print(f"SAVED {out_path}")
                break


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run(int(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]))

# MIDNIGHT // ROCKET RACER

Moody, stylized-futuristic arcade rocket racer — black-sky reflective world, neon light-rings, iridescent chrome, thin parametric line-geometry. Everything in the experience is 3D (diegetic frosted-glass panels in space, no flat DOM UI), in the spirit of Spline Hana.

Two additive slices live in this repo:

| Slice | Path | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **Web-native vertical slice** (Vite + Three.js) | `web/` | Playable — primary iteration target |
| **Unreal Engine 5.8 C++ slice** | `Source/`, `Config/`, `Content/` | Parked artifact — compiles, kept additive |

## Run the web slice

```bash
cd web
npm install
npm run dev   # http://localhost:8140
```

Controls: `W/S` throttle · `A/D` steer · `Shift` boost · `Space` drift/jump · `R` reset.

## Art direction (canon)

Sourced from Joey's Pinterest "Board" (4,263 pins), the Refract shader lineage, and the `iridescent_dotted_wave` Blender series:

- **Absolute black stage** — no grey studios, no skyboxes.
- **Glossy black-chrome + rainbow spectral rim** on hero surfaces.
- **Thin parametric line-geometry** — wireframe line-spheres, single-line tori, concentric dot-discs.
- **Neon light-rings** — blue / purple / cyan glowing torus loops; magenta and acid-lime accents.

"""Export the agent team's work into the repo:
- docs/agent-transcripts/  raw .jsonl transcripts (parent + subagents)
- docs/agent-reports/      polished markdown: each subagent's task + final answer
"""
import json
import re
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

SESSION = Path(r"C:\Users\joeyw\.cursor\projects\c-Users-joeyw\agent-transcripts\6164bccd-f056-4155-ae89-327373bc2e09")
REPO = Path(r"C:\Users\joeyw\Projects\MidnightRocketRacer")
TRANSCRIPTS = REPO / "docs" / "agent-transcripts"
REPORTS = REPO / "docs" / "agent-reports"


def text_of(message) -> str:
    content = message.get("content", "")
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    parts = []
    for block in content or []:
        if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "text":
            parts.append(block.get("text", ""))
        elif isinstance(block, str):
            parts.append(block)
    return "\n".join(parts)


def extract(path: Path):
    first_user, last_assistant = "", ""
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        try:
            event = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        message = event.get("message", event)
        role = message.get("role") or event.get("role")
        body = text_of(message).strip()
        if not body:
            continue
        if role == "user" and not first_user:
            first_user = body
        elif role == "assistant":
            last_assistant = body
    return first_user, last_assistant


def slug_for(task: str, uuid: str) -> str:
    first = next((l for l in task.splitlines() if l.strip()), uuid)
    words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9]+", first)[:6]
    return ("-".join(words).lower() or uuid)[:60]


def main():
    TRANSCRIPTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    REPORTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    shutil.copy2(SESSION / f"{SESSION.name}.jsonl", TRANSCRIPTS / f"parent-{SESSION.name}.jsonl")

    index_rows = []
    for sub in sorted((SESSION / "subagents").glob("*.jsonl")):
        shutil.copy2(sub, TRANSCRIPTS / f"subagent-{sub.name}")
        task, answer = extract(sub)
        if not answer:
            continue
        uuid = sub.stem
        slug = slug_for(task, uuid)
        report = REPORTS / f"{slug}--{uuid[:8]}.md"
        task_trimmed = task if len(task) < 4000 else task[:4000] + "\n\n*(task brief truncated)*"
        report.write_text(
            f"# Agent report — {slug.replace('-', ' ')}\n\n"
            f"**Subagent transcript:** `docs/agent-transcripts/subagent-{sub.name}`\n\n"
            f"## Task brief\n\n{task_trimmed}\n\n"
            f"## Final answer\n\n{answer}\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        index_rows.append(f"- [{slug.replace('-', ' ')}]({report.name}) — `{uuid[:8]}`")
        print(f"REPORT {report.name}")

    (REPORTS / "INDEX.md").write_text(
        "# Agent team reports — Midnight Rocket Racer session\n\n"
        "Polished final answers from every subagent in the build session, with raw JSONL transcripts alongside in `../agent-transcripts/`.\n\n"
        + "\n".join(index_rows) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(f"DONE {len(index_rows)} reports")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
